parts.name: DialogRoot
parts.description: Holds the dialog's open state and shares it with the parts inside it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the dialog.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the dialog is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a part, Escape or a press outside asks to open or close the dialog. A controlled dialog changes only when `open` does, so it can refuse to close. It is called in a change of its own, after the dialog's: a request it starts, or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the dialog. The owner may answer late (write `open` after an `await`) or guess (`guess open := next`); the dialog follows either way.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the dialog is opened with `showModal()`: in the top layer, with a backdrop, the page behind it inert and its scroll locked. With `false` it is opened with `show()` and the page stays usable.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether Escape and a press outside close the dialog. With `false` only its own buttons do.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Whether a press outside is ignored. Escape still closes the dialog.

props.name: role
props.description: The popup's role. `"alertdialog"` is written on the `<dialog>`; AlertDialogRoot sets it.

parts.name: DialogTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens the dialog. It carries `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual emphasis of the action, on the same scale as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: The height and padding of the button, on the same scale as Button.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the dialog is open.

parts.name: DialogPopup
parts.description: The `<dialog>` element. Style it with `[open]`, `::backdrop`, `@starting-style` and `[data-ending-style]`. Its `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` point at the title and description.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the dialog animates out. The dialog stays open until the transitions and animations on it and its descendants finish.

parts.name: DialogTitle
parts.description: A heading that names the dialog. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

parts.name: DialogDescription
parts.description: A paragraph that describes the dialog. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

parts.name: DialogClose
parts.description: A button that closes the dialog. In a controlled dialog it asks through `onOpenChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual emphasis of the action, on the same scale as Button.

props.name: size
props.description: The height and padding of the button, on the same scale as Button.

parts.name: DialogFooter
parts.description: A Glaze layout part: the row of actions that ends the popup. Put the primary action last.
